# Coverage and depth

| Capability | Owner / depth | Validation boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Decode shape/layout/scales/features and capacity versus scratch | decode-contract; selected owner/native-consumer chain and explicit helper domain | Declared metadata only; compiler/device/storage/dispatch not_run |
| Prefill query/layout/absolute positions/masks/ranges/workspace | prefill-contract; host parser/common MSL consumer, native assertions, bounded metadata/formulas | Helpers are not attention/reference emulation; actual native tensors blocked |
| Actual-model prewarm/pipeline caches/test evidence | qualification; actual layer/device/feature/limit derivation and process-wide cache identity | Source boundary inventory only; prepared name is not dispatch/parity |
| Model/scheduler/server/quantization/agentic/CUDA/distributed | root named gap map and narrow context | No implied full-repository or backend qualification |

Rubric: concrete inputs, invariants, owner/consumer, safe helper/schema, local references and troubleshooting/stop conditions. Unsupported source domains differ from supported-but-unverified.
